title_internal: Speak English for 30 seconds. Right now.

rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Stopwatch reads 00:30 in first frame and final frame; viewer doesn't notice loop kicked in
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: Faint wall clock visible in background reflection of stopwatch glass - only readable on watch #2
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens with 'Bet you can't' (challenge framing). Closes with 'That stumble is the muscle' (failure reframed as progress)
rewatch_engineering.info_density: Three nested instructions in 7 seconds - viewers pause to re-process
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Caption pops sync to stopwatch tick (1.0s intervals)

beats.visual: Extreme macro: stopwatch face, hand on 00:30, dramatic lighting
beats.caption: Bet you can't.

beats.visual: POV pan around a room - couch, lamp, mug, plant - quick whip transitions
beats.caption: Look around. | Pick THREE.
beats.voice_line: Look around the room. Right now. Pick three objects.

beats.visual: Tight close-up on lips silhouette, gold rim-light
beats.caption: Describe them. | Out loud. | English. | 30 seconds.
beats.audio: low piano note holds under voice
beats.voice_line: Describe them out loud. In English. Thirty seconds.

beats.visual: Stopwatch zooms back in, finger hovering over start button
beats.caption: GO

beats.visual: Stopwatch face, second hand sweeping 30 -> 0. Cut every 3-4s to a different room object (couch, lamp, mug, window, plant, book, cup, chair). Faint reflection of WALL CLOCK in stopwatch glass - hidden detail.
beats.caption: [live timer overlay top-right: 00:30 down to 00:00]

beats.visual: Stopwatch hits 00:00, single soft DING, screen fades to black
beats.caption: If you stumbled. | Good.

beats.visual: Black screen. White text fades up: 'That stumble is the muscle that becomes fluency.' Then quick flash back to stopwatch at 00:30 (matches first frame for loop trick)
beats.caption: That stumble | is the muscle | that becomes | FLUENCY.
beats.audio: low piano resolves on final word
beats.voice_line: That stumble is the muscle that becomes fluency.

captions_style.animation: instant pop in (no fade), 0.08s scale bump on entry

compliance.ai_voice_disclosure: toggle 'Altered or synthetic content' at upload
compliance.originality: original script, original framing, derived from FluentDrift Episode 1
